circuit:
* Differential sample-and-hold, 100 MHz single external clock.
*
* Track = clk high, hold = clk low (sample taken on the falling edge).
*
* Each sampling capacitor (CSP/CSN) is tied directly to its input, and its
* top plate (vtopp/vtopn) is switched to vcm during track. The top-plate
* switch only ever conducts at vcm, so its gate is bootstrapped to ~vcm+VDD
* and the on-resistance, channel charge and turn-off instant are all
* signal independent. No switch carries signal-dependent tracking current.
*
* vsp/vsn is a replica node: CRP/CRN couples it to the input, XNRP/XNRN
* shorts it to the input during track (CRP then carries ~0 V, so this switch
* carries no tracking current), and CGP/CGN plus the switch overlap match
* the top plate's parasitic ratio. In hold both vsp and vtopp follow the
* input with the same attenuation, so (vsp - vtopp) keeps the sample and
* the hold-phase coupling of the top-plate switch cancels.

.subckt bps_inv in out vdd vss
XP out in vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=1
XN out in vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
.ends bps_inv

XP out in vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
XN out in vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.5 nf=1

* Bootstrapped gate driver referenced to vcm:
* g = 0 while on is low; g ~ vcm+VDD while on is high.
* PMOS bodies sit on the boosted node a so no junction is forward biased.
.subckt bps_boost on onb g vcm vdd vss
CB a b 1.2p
XMNB b onb vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XMNBV vcm g b vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=1

circuit:
* Differential bottom-plate sample-and-hold.
*
* Each side:
*   - The input pin drives the bottom plate of the sampling capacitor
*     through an always-on complementary transmission gate.  Both device
*     bulks connect to the input node, so there is no body effect; the
*     NMOS and PMOS widths are ratioed so the two overdrives complement
*     and the series resistance is nearly signal independent.
*   - The top plate is switched to vcm by an NMOS whose source is the
*     fixed vcm node.  The gate is precharged to VDD-Vth by an NMOS gated
*     by the clock while a delayed clock is still low; the delayed clock
*     then boosts the gate through a coupling capacitor, so its overdrive
*     is about VDD even with the source at vcm and the body effect.  A
*     clocked pull-down holds the gate at zero during hold.
*   - At the falling clock edge the top plate is released and the
*     capacitor charge is frozen; the floating top plate follows the
*     input, so the stored differential voltage is held while the input
*     moves.  The switch source is the fixed vcm, so the sampling instant
*     and the injected charge are signal independent.
*
* Only ideal capacitors and sky130 1.8 V MOS devices are used.

* Minimum-size CMOS inverter (fast clock inversion / first delay stage).
.subckt bp_inv a y vdd vss
XN y a vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.42 nf=1
XP y a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.84 nf=1
.ends bp_inv

* Medium inverter for the loaded delay node.
.subckt bp_inv_m a y vdd vss
XN y a vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XP y a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=1
.ends bp_inv_m

* Strong inverter that drives the bootstrap coupling capacitor.
.subckt bp_inv_s a y vdd vss
XN y a vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=8 nf=1
XP y a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=16 nf=1
.ends bp_inv_s

* Always-on input transmission gate (bulk tied to source => no body effect).
.subckt bp_in_tg vin vsp vdd vss
XBN vsp vdd vin vin sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=320 nf=8
XBP vsp vss vin vin sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=800 nf=20
.ends bp_in_tg

.subckt bottom_plate_sampler vinp vinn clk vcm vdd vss vsp vsn vtopp vtopn

* Always-on bottom-plate connections.  Four identical gates in parallel
* per side keep the series resistance low enough that its residual
* curvature contributes well below -80 dBc.
XBP1 vinp vsp vdd vss bp_in_tg
XBP2 vinp vsp vdd vss bp_in_tg
XBP3 vinp vsp vdd vss bp_in_tg
XBP4 vinp vsp vdd vss bp_in_tg
XBN1 vinn vsn vdd vss bp_in_tg
XBN2 vinn vsn vdd vss bp_in_tg
XBN3 vinn vsn vdd vss bp_in_tg
XBN4 vinn vsn vdd vss bp_in_tg

* Complement of clk for the gate pull-down (fast, no added delay).
XINV clk clkb vdd vss bp_inv

* Delayed clock: RC stage followed by a strong driver, so the gate
* precharge is complete before the boost edge arrives.
XDL1 clk dl1 vdd vss bp_inv
CD1 dl1 vss 150f
XDL2 dl1 dl2 vdd vss bp_inv_m
CD2 dl2 vss 30f
XDL3 dl2 dl3 vdd vss bp_inv_s
XDL4 dl3 clkd vdd vss bp_inv_s

* Bootstrapped gate drive for the top-plate switches.
*   XPRE : precharges gate_b to VDD-Vth while clk is high and clkd still low.
*   CBST : couples the delayed clock edge to gate_b, adding ~VDD.
*   XPD  : holds gate_b at ground while clk is low.
XPRE vdd clk gate_b vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=10 nf=1
CBST clkd gate_b 300f
XPD gate_b clkb vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=16 nf=1

* Top-plate sampling switches (source fixed at vcm, bulk at vss).
XTP vtopp gate_b vcm vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=8 nf=2
XTN vtopn gate_b vcm vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=8 nf=2

* Sampling capacitors: bottom plate to top plate.
CSP vsp vtopp 2p
CSN vsn vtopn 2p

.ends bottom_plate_sampler

circuit:
* Differential bottom-plate sample-and-hold.
*
* Sampling core (per side):
*   vinp (bottom plate) --CSP-- vtopp (floating top plate) --[XTN]-- vcm
*
* The input drives the bottom plate directly, so no switch resistance is in
* the acquisition path.  During track the top plate is held at vcm through
* XTN; during hold the plate floats and follows the input with the capacitor
* charge frozen.
*
* The top-switch gate is boosted above vdd during track by a flying-cap
* bootstrap: CBST is diode-charged (XDB) during hold, XBH/XBT return its
* bottom node to vss/vcm, and XBS connects it to the gate rail while the
* clock is low.  CKICK adds a fixed clock-coupled boost.  The boosted gate
* keeps the switch overdrive high across the input swing, so the tracking
* error stays signal-linear.  During hold XGD pulls the gate hard to vss,
* independent of the held signal.
*
* The main-switch bulk is clock-switched: vcm during track (zero source-bulk
* bias, maximum on-current) and vss during hold (both junctions reverse
* biased while the plate node is at vcm).
*
* vsp/vsn are sense outputs.  Each is driven by a complementary N/P pair whose
* gates are AC-coupled to its own input with a large capacitor and biased to
* vdd/vss during track; each pair is operated with source and bulk tied
* together, so there is no body effect and the sense link is linear while it
* tracks the input during hold.
*
* Stored differential output = (vsp - vtopp) - (vsn - vtopn).
*
.subckt bottom_plate_sampler vinp vinn clk vcm vdd vss vsp vsn vtopp vtopn
CSP vinp vtopp 2.3p

* Differential bottom-plate sample-and-hold.
*
* Per side:
*   - sampling capacitor C between the "sample" pin (top plate) and the
*     "top" pin (bottom plate).
*   - the top plate is driven by an always-on CMOS transmission gate.  It
*     never switches, so it injects no charge and adds no aperture
*     uncertainty; its finite on resistance only produces a small
*     quadrature tracking error.
*   - the bottom plate is switched to the fixed mid-rail vcm by an NMOS.
*     Both of its terminals sit at vcm while it conducts, so its channel
*     charge, its on-resistance and its turn-off instant are independent
*     of the input - that is what makes this a bottom-plate sampler.
*   - Cx ties the bottom plate to its own input pin.  With the sampling
*     switch off that pin holds the bottom plate, so an input step moves
*     the stored voltage by only C_par/(C+Cx+C_par), C_par being the
*     sampling switch drain overlap capacitance.
*   - the sampling switch gate is driven from the clock through a
*     coupling capacitor.  Its level is bounded from below by an NMOS
*     whose gate is vcm (so it only conducts while the gate is below
*     vcm-Vth, i.e. in hold) and from above by a PMOS diode clocked by
*     clk (so it only conducts while the gate is above clk+|Vthp|, i.e.
*     during the clock high phase).  The gate therefore swings from
*     about 0.3 V in hold - hard off even though the bottom plate falls
*     to ~0.1 V - to about 2.0 V in track, which is strong enough to
*     settle the sampled node in a couple of ns.

.subckt bottom_plate_sampler vinp vinn clk vcm vdd vss vsp vsn vtopp vtopn

* ---------------- positive side ----------------
Csp  vsp   vtopp 0.05p
Cxp  vtopp vinp  6p
* always-on top plate transmission gate
XTPN vsp   vdd   vinp  vss   sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1000 nf=8
XTPP vsp   vss   vinp  vinp  sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1000 nf=8
* bottom plate sampling switch
XBP  vtopp gbp   vcm   vss   sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=40 nf=4
Cbp  clk   gbp   1p
* hold level of the sampling gate: lower bound and upper bound
XUB  vdd   vcm   gbp   vss   sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=1
XDB  vss   clk   gbp   gbp   sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=5 w=0.42 nf=1

* ---------------- negative side ----------------
Csn  vsn   vtopn 0.05p
Cxn  vtopn vinn  6p
XTNN vsn   vdd   vinn  vss   sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1000 nf=8
XTNP vsn   vss   vinn  vinn  sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1000 nf=8
XBN  vtopn gbn   vcm   vss   sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=40 nf=4
Cbn  clk   gbn   1p
XUN  vdd   vcm   gbn   vss   sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=1
XDN  vss   clk   gbn   gbn   sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=5 w=0.42 nf=1

.ends bottom_plate_sampler

circuit:
* Differential bottom-plate sample-and-hold (true bottom-plate topology).
*
* One channel (sampling input vI onto output pins vY=bottom plate, vX=top):
*   Cs between vX and vY.
*   track: S3 (NMOS, gate clk)  ties the bottom plate vY to vcm;
*          S1 (transmission gate, NMOS gate clkd, PMOS gate clkb) ties the
*          top plate vX to the input vI. Cs charges to vI - vcm.
*   hold turn-off order:
*     1) clk falls  -> S3 opens first, bottom plate floats at vcm
*                       (signal-independent switch, fixed potential);
*     2) clkb rises -> S1 PMOS opens while its NMOS still conducts, charge
*                       returns to the stiff input;
*     3) clkd falls -> S1 NMOS opens last: both plates are already floating,
*                       so its signal-dependent injection moves vX and vY
*                       together and the across-capacitor voltage is retained.
*   Held across-cap voltage: vY - vX = vcm - vI.
*
* The differential output is (vsp-vtopp) - (vsn-vtopn); because each channel
* stores vcm - vI, the two inputs are cross-wired so the differential stored
* value equals vinp - vinn.
*
* clkb = ~clk (one inverter delay), clkd = clk (two inverter delays).

.subckt bps_inv in out vdd vss
XI0 out in vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.0 nf=1
XI1 out in vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2.0 nf=1
.ends bps_inv

* One sampling channel: input vi -> bottom plate vb, top plate vt.
* Stores vb - vt = vcm - vi.
.subckt bps_chan vi vb vt vcm clkd clkb clk vdd vss
* input transmission gate on the top plate: vi <-> vt
XTGN vt clkd vi vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=20 nf=4
XTGP vt clkb vi vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=50 nf=10
* bottom-plate switch to the fixed common mode: vb <-> vcm (opens first)
XS3  vb clk  vcm vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=30 nf=6
* sampling capacitor between top and bottom plates
CS   vt vb 0.4p
.ends bps_chan

.subckt bottom_plate_sampler vinp vinn clk vcm vdd vss vsp vsn vtopp vtopn
* local clock phases
XINV1 clk  clkb vdd vss bps_inv
XINV2 clkb clkd vdd vss bps_inv

* Cross-wired: the channel on the (vsp,vtopp) pins samples vinn and the one
* on (vsn,vtopn) samples vinp, so (vsp-vtopp)-(vsn-vtopn) = vinp - vinn.
XCHP vinn vsp vtopp vcm clkd clkb clk vdd vss bps_chan
XCHN vinp vsn vtopn vcm clkd clkb clk vdd vss bps_chan
.ends bottom_plate_sampler

* Differential bottom-plate sample-and-hold.
*
* Top-level pins (fixed interface):
*   vinp vinn   : differential input (common mode vcm = VDD/2)
*   clk         : 0..VDD 100 MHz sample clock, driven through 50 ohms
*   vcm         : common-mode reference (VDD/2)
*   vdd vss     : supplies
*   vsp vsn     : sampled (input-side / bottom) plates
*   vtopp vtopn : vcm-side (top) plates
* Stored differential quantity: (vsp-vtopp) - (vsn-vtopn)
*
* Sampling sequence (clk high = track):
*   phi1 (early, =clk buffered) drives the vcm reset TGs on the top plates.
*   phi2 (same phase, delayed ~200 ps) drives the bootstrapped input switches.
*   At the falling (sample) edge the top-plate reset TGs open FIRST while the
*   input switches are still closed: the top plate floats while the bottom plate
*   is still held at vin, so the sample (vin-vcm) is frozen there. The input
*   switches open ~200 ps later; they are bootstrapped (constant Vgs = VDD), so
*   their on-resistance and channel charge are signal independent -> no harmonic
*   distortion or signal-dependent gain.
*
* ---- clock inverters (fixed geometry; numeric literals required) ----
.subckt inv_s a z vdd vss
XN z a vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.0 nf=1
XP z a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2.0 nf=1
.ends inv_s
.subckt inv_m a z vdd vss
XN z a vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=6.0 nf=2
XP z a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=12.0 nf=2
.ends inv_m
.subckt inv_l a z vdd vss
XN z a vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=16.0 nf=4
XP z a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=32.0 nf=4
.ends inv_l
* ---- transmission gate (used for the signal-independent vcm reset path) ----
.subckt tg a b gn gp vdd vss
XN a gn b vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=16.0 nf=4
XP a gp b vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=32.0 nf=4
.ends tg
*
* ---- bootstrapped (constant-Vgs) sampling switch ----
* in  : signal input ; out : sampling (bottom) plate
* ph  : track phase (high = track) ; phb : hold phase (high = hold)
* In hold the bootstrap cap Cb is precharged to VDD (ct=vdd, cb=vss) and the
* sampling-FET gate g is pulled to vss (switch off). In track Cb is stacked
* between g and in, giving g = in + VDD so the sampling FET sees a constant
* Vgs = VDD independent of input level. PMOS bulks ride the boot node so no
* junction is forward biased and the n-well follows the high boot voltage.
.subckt boot_sw in out ph phb vdd vss
* sampling FET (d=out g=g s=in b=vss)
XMS out g in vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=16.0 nf=4
* bootstrap capacitor between ct (top) and cb (bottom); large so the gate
* boost stays at VDD through the full input swing (Cb >> sampling-FET Cgg)
CB  ct cb 2.0p
* precharge ct to vdd in hold (PMOS, gate=ph low in hold -> on; bulk on ct)
XPC ct ph vdd ct  sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.35 w=8.0 nf=2
* precharge cb to vss in hold (NMOS, gate=phb high in hold -> on)
XNC cb phb vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.35 w=6.0 nf=2
* connect ct to g in track (PMOS, gate=phb low in track -> on; bulk on ct)
XCG g  phb ct ct  sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.35 w=12.0 nf=4
* connect cb to in in track via a TRANSMISSION GATE (full 0.5..1.3 V range;
* NMOS gate=ph, PMOS gate=phb; PMOS bulk rides in)
XCN cb ph  in vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.35 w=6.0 nf=2
XCP cb phb in in  sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.35 w=12.0 nf=4
* pull g to vss in hold (NMOS, gate=phb high in hold -> on)
XPG g  phb vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.35 w=6.0 nf=2
.ends boot_sw

.subckt bottom_plate_sampler vinp vinn clk vcm vdd vss vsp vsn vtopp vtopn
* --- clock buffer: clk -> phi1 (same phase), tapered for drive (4 inversions)
XIC0 clk  b1   vdd vss inv_s
XIC1 b1   b2   vdd vss inv_s
XIC2 b2   b3   vdd vss inv_m
XIC3 b3   phi1 vdd vss inv_l

* Terminals sit at fixed vcm -> charge injection signal independent.

* sampled bottom plate (vsp) and the top plate (vtopp); the top plate is tied to
* the vcm reference by a permanently-on transmission gate, so the stored value
* is (vsp-vcm) and the stored differential output is (vsp-vtopp)-(vsn-vtopn).
*
* The input drives the bottom plate through a bootstrapped NMOS whose gate sits
* at (vin + Vcap) during track and at 0 during hold, so the switch overdrive is
* set by the bootstrap capacitor rather than by the clock swing.  That keeps the
* channel charge it dumps on the hold capacitor nearly independent of the input
* level, which is what holds the sampling gain error and distortion down.
*
* Bootstrap cell (one per side):
*   Cb   between T and X
*   XMNS sampling switch,  d=vsp  g=G  s=vinp b=vss
*   XMD  gate discharge,    d=G    g=clkb s=vss   (hold)
*   XMPRE T precharge,      d=vdd  g=vdd  s=T     (hold; strong enough to
*                                                  recharge Cb within 5 ns)
*   XMR  X reset,           d=X    g=clkbd s=vss  (hold)
*   XMTN/XMTP  X to input transmission gate       (track)
*   XMC  T-to-G switch,     d=T    g=clkb s=G  b=T (track)
* During hold G=0 and X=0, so the bootstrap capacitor recharges towards
* vdd-vth through XMPRE.  During track X follows vinp and XMC connects T to G,
* so the gate rises to vinp+Vcap and the switch overdrive is Vcap.
*
* The precharge body is returned to vcm rather than to vss: that removes most
* of its body effect, so Cb recharges closer to vdd-vth0 and the switch
* overdrive Vcap is larger (lower Ron, and a Vcap that varies less with the
* input).  vcm also keeps both source and drain junctions reverse biased in
* every phase, which tying the body to T or vdd does not.
*
* clkbd is clkb after two inverters.  It delays the X reset by only a few tens
* of ps but takes the large XMR gate load off clkb, so the clkb edge that turns
* the sampling switch off is not disturbed by the reset current.  Delaying that
* reset further, or slowing its edge, starves the Cb recharge and raises the
* distortion sharply.

*     from the delayed phase T so the input switch opens LAST.

*     boosted to ~vcm+VDD in track; opens FIRST on the falling edge (the
*     signal-independent sampling instant).  One small NMOS junction is the
*     only signal-dependent parasitic on the floating bottom plate.
*   - clamp: transmission gate from top plate to vcm, ON in hold.
* Fall edge: bottom switch opens, clamp closes (top plate -> vcm, bottom
* plate follows by capacitor coupling), input switch opens last into the
* clamped top plate so its channel charge is absorbed by vcm.
* Rise edge: clamp opens before the input switch closes.
* Held cap voltage: v(top)-v(bottom) = vin_sampled - vcm.

* Each hold capacitor has its top plate switched to vcm and its bottom plate
* switched to the input.  On the clock falling edge the top-plate switch opens
* first (gated directly by clk/clk_bar) while the bottom plate is still pinned
* to the input; a delayed clock then opens the bottom switch.  This bottom-plate
* sequence turns the bottom-switch charge injection into a common-mode shift of
* the floating capacitor, so the held differential voltage is nearly exact.
*
*   stored differential = (vinp - vcm) - (vinn - vcm) = vinp - vinn
*   stored common mode = 0.5*((vinp - vcm) + (vinn - vcm)) = 0 (input CM = vcm)
*
* The top-plate switch is a transmission gate so it stays strongly on across
* all process corners (a bare NMOS loses gate drive at ss/1.62V).  Extra
* bottom-plate capacitance to vss (CGP/CGN) attenuates the signal-dependent
* portion of the bottom-switch injection, which is the source of gain error.

* The bottom switch is an Abo-Gray bootstrap NMOS switch: a floating capacitor
* (CBSP/CBSN) is charged to vdd during hold and then lifted by the input during
* track, driving the switch gate to vin + vdd.  This gives a constant Vgs ~= vdd
* and a signal-independent Ron, removing the tracking-lag distortion that
* limited SFDR to ~53 dB with a plain transmission-gate bottom switch.  The
* PMOS devices that touch the bootstrap node (asp/asn) have their n-well bulk
* tied to that node so the source-bulk diodes stay reverse biased even though

* A CMOS inverter chain produces staggered complementary phases:

*   clk -> n1 -> phi1/phi1b (bottom TGs, open early)
*              -> phi/phib   (input TGs, open ~two gate delays later)
*              -> phid/phibd (half-size dummy switches, close just after)

* then absorb the input switches' (signal-dependent) charge at the sampling
* node.  Bottom switches are wide transmission gates: near the 0.9 V target

* width keeps the acquisition time constant small in both directions.

* Differential bottom-plate sample-and-hold.
* One external clock (clk): high = track, low = hold.
*
* Top plate (vtopp/vtopn): biased to vcm during track through a CMOS TG driven
*   directly by clk/clkbar. It freezes on the clk falling edge -> defines a
*   signal-independent sampling instant. The frozen top-plate charge holds the
*   cap voltage; the bottom-plate switch state during hold is irrelevant to the
*   stored value, so the bottom switch need not (and does not) switch off.
*
* Bottom plate (vsp/vsn): driven to vinp/vinn through a BOOTSTRAPPED switch
*   whose main NMOS sees a constant Vgs=VDD during track. Constant on-resistance
*   makes the track-time voltage drop a linear (gain/phase-only) function of the
*   input, eliminating signal-dependent (3rd-harmonic) distortion. The main
*   transistor stays conducting during hold (its gate held at VDD by the
*   precharge devices); because the top plate is frozen the stored cap voltage is
*   still preserved, so hold isolation holds.
*
* Stored differential = (vsp-vtopp)-(vsn-vtopn) = vinp-vinn. All charge
* injection is common-mode (top-plate TG) or lands on a non-storage node, so it
* cancels differentially.

 * and Vgs is constant across the whole input swing.  A constant-Vgs switch
 * has a flat, input-independent on-resistance; the transmission-gate it
 * replaces had a strongly arched R_on(vin) whose curvature, multiplied by
 * the tracking lag, was the dominant distortion mechanism.
 *   NG  switch gate (rides vin+VDD during track, vss during hold)
 *   NT  CB top plate; precharged to vdd each hold by XPT (self-gated from NG)
 *   NB  CB bottom plate; tied to vin during track, vss during hold
 * Switch phasing (track high): XISO/XPD/XNB on phdb, XNBTN on phd, XNBTP on
 * phdb.  At the track edge XISO closes early in the phdb fall while NB is
 * still low, which is what establishes the constant Vgs.

 * phd/phdb the same phase delayed for the input switch family.

* Differential bottom-plate sample-and-hold driven by one external clock.
*
* clk high = track. Each side: sampling capacitor CS between the bottom-plate
* node (vsp/vsn) and the top-plate node (vtopp/vtopn). The top-plate
* transmission gate is driven by the undelayed clock and opens first. The
* bottom-plate switch is a single bootstrapped nfet. During hold the boot
* capacitor is precharged (a ~ VDD-|Vthp| via pfet XPA, b = 0 via XNB); early
* in track, b is joined to vsp and a to the switch gate, leaving Vgs of the
* switch near 1.2 V over the whole input range. Sampling happens a few gate
* delays after the top plate opens: the pulse pgate turns on XG, which drags
* the switch gate toward vin + Vth (source follower), so the switch pinches
* off right as g reaches vin + Vth and the post-pinch-off gate swing is nearly
* signal-independent. Afterwards XGH re-biases the gate to about vin - Vth so
* the main switch stays safely off over the full hold swing. Cross-coupled
* trim capacitors cancel the main-switch overlap capacitance during hold.
* Note: sky130 wrapper w= is TOTAL width; w/nf is the per-finger width.

* --- local helpers --------------------------------------------------------

.subckt bps_inv2 vi vo vd vs
XN vo vi vs vs sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XP vo vi vd vd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=1
.ends bps_inv2

.subckt bps_inv6 vi vo vd vs
XN vo vi vs vs sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=16 nf=4
XP vo vi vd vd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=24 nf=6
.ends bps_inv6

.subckt bps_nor2 vi1 vi2 vo vd vs
XN1 vo vi1 vs vs sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=1
XN2 vo vi2 vs vs sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=1
XP1 vo vi1 vd vd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=14 nf=2
XP2 vo vi2 vd vd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=14 nf=2
.ends bps_nor2

* --- one side of the sampler ----------------------------------------------

.subckt bps_cell vin vsp vtop vcm vdd vss clk2 clk2bar pgate
* top-plate switch to vcm (opens first, undelayed clock)
XTN vcm clk2 vtop vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=72 nf=16
XTP vcm clk2bar vtop vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=144 nf=32
* sampling capacitor
CS vsp vtop 2p
* bottom-plate switch: bootstrapped nfet, sample defined at pinch-off
XS vin g vsp vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=56 nf=14
* boot capacitor and swap network
CB a b 400f
XPA a clk2 vdd a sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=1
XNB b clk2bar vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XC1 g clk2bar a a sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XC2 b clk2 vsp vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=1
* sampling: pgate pulse drags g to vin+Vth (XG source follower), defining the
* sample at pinch-off with almost no post-pinch gate swing.
XG g pgate vin vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=24 nf=6
* hold gate re-bias: g -> vin - Vth, keeps XS off over the full hold swing
XGH vcm vin g vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=6 nf=1
.ends bps_cell

* --- top level --------------------------------------------------------------

.subckt bottom_plate_sampler vinp vinn clk vcm vdd vss vsp vsn vtopp vtopn

* clock conditioning: buffers
XI1 clk n1 vdd vss bps_inv2
XI2 n1 clk2 vdd vss bps_inv6
XI2B clk2 clk2bar vdd vss bps_inv6
* sampling pulse: pgate = NOR(clk2, delayed clk2bar). It rises one gate after
* clk2 falls (just after the top plate starts to break) and ends when the
* delayed clk2bar arrives, a few gate delays later.
XI3 clk2bar d1 vdd vss bps_inv2
XI4 d1 d2 vdd vss bps_inv2
XI5 d2 d3 vdd vss bps_inv2
XPG clk2 d3 pgate vdd vss bps_nor2

XCELLP vinp vsp vtopp vcm vdd vss clk2 clk2bar pgate bps_cell
XCELLN vinn vsn vtopn vcm vdd vss clk2 clk2bar pgate bps_cell

* cross-coupled trim capacitors: cancel XS overlap coupling during hold
CCP vsp vinn 15f
CCN vsn vinp 15f

.ends bottom_plate_sampler

* Differential bottom-plate sample-and-hold with bootstrapped plate switches.
*
* Each plate switch is an NMOS whose drain is the input node and whose source
* is the held plate node. The gate is bootstrapped to source + overdrive during
* track (constant Vgs -> constant Ron, signal-independent injection) and is
* returned to source potential during hold (Vgs = 0, off, immune to input
* reversal). Referencing the bootstrap to the held node lets the switch start
* tracking from 0 V (Vgs = full boost at vsp = 0) and stay off while the input
* reverses during hold.
*
* Identical switches on both plates -> matched fixed injection -> stored
* capacitor voltage error ~0; fixed offsets cancel differentially.
*
* Stored differential = (vsp - vtopp) - (vsn - vtopn) = vinp - vinn

.subckt bottom_plate_sampler vinp vinn clk vcm vdd vss vsp vsn vtopp vtopn

* ---- Positive side: bottom plate vinp -> vsp ----
XMB vinp Gb vsp vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=16.0 nf=1
Cb  clk Gb 80f
Csb Gb vsp 8f

* ---- Positive side: top plate vcm -> vtopp ----
XMT vcm Gt vtopp vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=16.0 nf=1
Ct  clk Gt 80f
Cst Gt vtopp 8f

CP vsp vtopp 100f

* ---- Negative side: bottom plate vinn -> vsn ----
XMN vinn Gn vsn vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=16.0 nf=1
Cn  clk Gn 80f
Csn Gn vsn 8f

* ---- Negative side: top plate vcm -> vtopn ----
XNT vcm Gnt vtopn vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=16.0 nf=1
Cnt clk Gnt 80f
Cnts Gnt vtopn 8f

CPn vsn vtopn 100f
.ends bottom_plate_sampler
